fusions.name: Felling Cut
fusions.desc: Chops one enemy for 14 damage, knocking it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Timber Fall
fusions.desc: Fells a trunk across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy under it and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Coppice
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Sugaring Off
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain 20% lifedrain for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
